The Rise, 275 Montreal Street, Christchurch Central.
Five full-floor three-bedroom residences (Ground 127.3 m2 gross; Levels 1-4 148.4 m2 gross), each with a 30 m2 west deck, plus a rooftop wellness pavilion with sauna, spa, gym and 40 m2 terrace. Gated forecourt with five parks.
Concept design, not yet consented. Marketed by Angela Webb, Bayleys Christchurch, +64 27 349 1997.
